turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of a class?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Now tell me what you based it on.

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. Kids draft in a notes app and paste it in, Hale, so this shows when it arrived, not who wrote it. And was Owen asked about any of this before you entered the zero?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
You've told me when it was pasted, not who wrote it. You still haven't answered me: did you speak to Owen before that zero went in?
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the witness here. Answer my question or I'm going upstairs: was Owen heard before the zero?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, a straight answer on whether Owen was heard before it was entered, and confirmation that nothing about this is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a promise that nothing goes on his record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Owning the early zero in one sentence earned a small sign of ground, because it took away the procedural attack she came in with.
What cost ground: You twice skipped her question about whether Owen was spoken to first, then asked what he was doing at midnight, which turned the meeting toward her home instead of the essay.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the essay's arrival just before midnight on October 28, very close to that kind of night, which is why she went short and hard; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said he could have drafted elsewhere and pasted it in, answer her question about whether Owen was heard, then offer the private supervised rewrite under 4.4 in writing instead of pressing on the timestamps.
